title: Android Back from a selector popup also closes the drawer
severity_basis: Unexpected extra navigation requires reopening the drawer. No saved-list changes or loss were observed.
environment: Qt 6.12, isolated QShopper_API_36 Android 16 emulator-5580, gesture navigation, existing x86_64 debug APK.
expected: User clarified on 2026-10-31: Close only the selector popup first. Leave the drawer open; another Back closes the drawer while preserving edit mode.
reproduction: Launch with unique QSHOPPER_DATA_DIR and an isolated milk/bread fixture.
Enter edit mode, open the drawer, and open Lists, Accent or Primary.
Perform a completed Android left-edge Back gesture while the selector popup is open.
Observe that both popup and drawer close; editing and saved items remain.
observed: Original strict run reproduced extra drawer dismissal for all three selectors. An earlier run left Accent open. The subsequent touch regression established the initial outside press as the cause; see root_cause and before/after evidence.

regression.before: Native baseline: 3 selector failures and 7 passing Back/data controls. New QML outside-touch cases: 6 failures; 11 other records pass, including direct Key_Back routing. Original reports retained.
regression.after: All 17 focused QML records pass offscreen and with native Windows rendering. Full Windows configure/build/CTest passes all four entries: 157 UI, 19 flow, 6 keyboard and 61 model records (zero failures/skips). All 13 native Android checks pass from each edge (26 total), including next-Back drawer-only closure and retained draft/settings/data.
regression.platform_scope: Real Android Back gestures verified from both edges. Desktop Back/touch controls additionally cover outside press, cancellation and release; those controls alone do not certify native gesture handling.

implementation_scope: User selected UI-016 on 2026-10-31. Implement the popup-only Back behavior and regression coverage; no unrelated app refactoring.
root_cause: The selector closes on the initial outside touch at the edge, before Android recognizes Back and cancels that touch. The completed Back then reaches the drawer. Direct Key_Back selector/drawer ordering already passes without changing the app shortcut routing.

implementation.change: ComboBox.qml makes selector popups modal and closes them on outside release rather than outside press. CloseOnEscape and Qt native Back handling remain. Modal delivery is required for the release-outside policy and prevents a dismissing tap reaching controls below the popup.
implementation.tradeoff: Outside taps dismiss on release rather than press. A cancelled outside touch leaves the popup open. This supports deliberate one-handed interaction and avoids closing two layers from one system gesture.
implementation.qml_regression: tests/qml/tst_back.qml: three selector Back/drawer/edit sequences, plus six outside-touch cancel/release cases. The six touch cases fail with the original component at the initial-press assertion; all 17 focused offscreen records pass after the fix.
implementation.native_before: Existing --selector-back regression rerun on the original installed APK: all three selectors fail popup-only dismissal; seven Back/data controls pass. Report out/android-emulator/ui016-before/results.json.
implementation.native_after: Both left- and right-edge runs pass all 13 checks each (26 total), including next-Back drawer-only closure, retained editor draft, unchanged settings and saved items, keyboard/edit ordering and live-process background/return.
implementation.phone_validation: User confirmed the fix on an Android simulator on 2026-11-01 and requested closure and commit. This is emulator confirmation, not physical-phone validation. The shared-key ARM64 APK remains available; no physical-device installation was performed.
implementation.windows_after: ./tools/verify-windows.ps1: configure/build and all four CTest entries pass; 157 UI, 19 flow, 6 real-keyboard and 61 model records, zero failures/skips. Total 288.80 seconds. Focused native Windows rendering: 17 pass, zero failure/skip (18.071 seconds).
implementation.packaging: ARM64 build/signing script completes and the shared certificate is verified. x86_64 CMake/Gradle produces the fixed APK successfully; its script stalls in post-build recursive APK discovery, so that discovery is cancelled and the exact generated APK is copied to dist directly. Native tests use that freshly built APK; dist/generated SHA-256 matches 5174c9c27b30188c4dd7f622a98d8ed5dedf7ccaf000884044153eb0128164bb.
implementation.user_validation: 2026-11-01: user reported "Confirmed to on Android simulator. Close ticker and commit change." Accepted as Android emulator confirmation and authorization to close UI-016.
